patch_description: Builds on the current ILS but adds a 2-opt (segment reversal) neighborhood alongside relocation/swap in the local search, and uses simulated annealing acceptance with restarts to escape local optima. Key parameters: greedy construction, 2-opt + swap descent, SA with geometric cooling (T0=2.0, alpha=0.985) and temperature reheat on stagnation, ruin-and-recreate perturbation, 20s budget per workload. This reaches moves the adjacent/pairwise local search cannot, leading to lower makespan.
